name: Self-emptying

phase_0.boundary_condition: The limit of the finite vessel which must be vacated to receive the infinite.

VINIT.justification: The unmanifest state before the specific act of self-emptying begins.

TANCH.justification: The ultimate reality that contains both the emptying and the filling.

AFWD.justification: The directed movement of the self away from its own center.

AREV.justification: The contraction of the self to create internal space.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of individual acts of letting go.

IMSCRIB.justification: The persistent identity that recognizes its own process of dissolution.

FSPLIT.justification: The division of the self into the part that gives and the part that is given.

FFUSE.justification: The reconstitution of the self as a pure capacity for the other.

EVALT.justification: The successful achievement of an empty state.

EVALF.justification: The failure to empty due to residual clinging.

ENGAGR.justification: The simultaneous state of being totally empty yet totally present.

IFIX.justification: The irreversible change in the nature of the being after the act.

phase_3.void_description: The state before the intention to empty arises.
phase_3.true_description: The vessel is clear and ready for reception.
phase_3.false_description: The vessel remains obstructed by self-assertion.
phase_3.both_description: The paradox where the act of emptying is itself the fulfillment.

steps.domain_action: The pre-existent state of the self before kenosis.
The self identifies its own boundaries and contents.
The self begins the inward withdrawal to create space.
The self divides into the agent of emptying and the substance to be emptied.
The substance is poured out toward the external target.
The internal space is verified as vacant.
The agent and the vacant space reunite as a single capacity.
The act of emptying connects to the state of readiness.
The self holds the tension of being both the actor and the void.
The transition from a full vessel to an empty vessel is recorded as a permanent ontological shift.
The process concludes within the absolute ground of being.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The will or intention that directs the self-emptying process.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The resonance between the internal void and the external infinite.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The trace of what was surrendered which defines the shape of the void.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The rhythmic cycle of inhalation and exhalation or giving and receiving.
phase_5.alfs_store: The foundational scriptures or mystical traditions defining kenosis.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The psychic or spiritual energy required to overcome self-preservation.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: A self-contained, pressurized state of egoic fullness.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: A low-pressure, receptive state of open vacuity.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The energy lost in relinquishment is exactly balanced by the potential energy of the resulting receptivity.
